SELECT * FROM ( SELECT g.game_title AS gameTitle, r.review_contents AS reviewContents, TO_CHAR(r.write_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS writeDate, r.rating AS rating FROM gemdori_review_tbl r JOIN gemdori_game_tbl g ON r.game_code = g.game_code WHERE r.user_code = #{userCode} ORDER BY r.write_date DESC )
WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.purchase_code as purchaseCode, p.user_code as userCode, p.game_code as gameCode, p.purchase_date as purchaseDate, p.price as price, p.discount_rate as discountRate, p.payment_method as paymentMethod, p.purchase_status as purchaseStatus, g.game_title as gameTitle, g.GAME_MAIN_IMAGE as thumbnailImage FROM gemdori_purchase_history_table p JOIN gemdori_game_tbl g ON p.game_code = g.game_code WHERE p.user_code = #{userCode} ORDER BY p.purchase_date DESC )
WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
